data.code:
CLAUDE->OPENCODE PORT (module paper-review-claude-port-v1)

Produced files:
1. E:\opencode_harness_portable\packages\paper-review-plugin\manifest.json
   - Port of .claude-plugin/plugin.json (name/version/description/author/repository/license)
   - Extended with an "opencode" section mapping architecture (agents/*.md), commands, skills, MCP servers, contracts.
2. E:\opencode_harness_portable\packages\paper-review-plugin\package.json
   - ESM package metadata (@paper-review/opencode-plugin, main ./dist-v2/v2/index.js).
3. E:\opencode_harness_portable\packages\paper-review-plugin\dist-v2\v2\index.js
   - OpenCode V2 plugin (id paper-review.system.v2) replacing hooks/hooks.json:
     * setup(): resolves harness root, runs scripts/paper-review/check-deps.py --json with .venv python,
       persists result in ctx.storage, registers ctx.session.hook('context', ...) so a short system note
       is injected when required deps are missing; fully exception-safe (never breaks app).
4. E:\opencode_harness_portable\scripts\paper-review\check-deps.py
   - Windows/portable port of check-deps.sh (no bash): checks mcp/pymupdf/pydantic/httpx/PIL,
       optional marker; exits 0 when all required present, prints JSON with --json flag.
5. E:\opencode_harness_portable\.opencode\opencode.json
   - MCP env passthrough from .mcp.json added to academic-search:
       environment: { CROSSREF_MAILTO: {env:CROSSREF_MAILTO}, SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY: {env:SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY} }
   - paper-review-plugin registered in plugin[] (file:// URL to dist-v2/v2).
data.description: Ported the three Claude-specific plugin files (.claude-plugin/plugin.json, .mcp.json, hooks/hooks.json) to OpenCode-native equivalents: packages/paper-review-plugin (manifest + V2 plugin with the SessionStart-equivalent dependency hook), env passthrough for academic-search MCP, and a Windows-portable check-deps.py.

scope_in: Windows-compatible check-deps.py replacing check-deps.sh for the hook
scope_out: Claude plugin.json/.mcp.json/hooks.json remain as historical originals in C:\Temp\opencode\integration
No changes to existing harness MCP servers (coder_router, academic_search, doc_extract, searxng_search)

comments.problem: runDepsCheck spawns python without a timeout; a hung interpreter would keep the promise pending.
comments.suggestion: Acceptable for a short deps probe; document that check-deps.py is quick and the hook is best-effort. No blocking in setup awaited path beyond the probe.
comments.falsification: Run check-deps.py --json with a 120s timeout; if it exceeds the timeout the concern is real, otherwise it is not.

comments.problem: harnessRoot() falls back to packageRoot/../.. which depends on the plugin being inside packages/paper-review-plugin; if copied elsewhere it resolves wrongly.
comments.suggestion: OK for the harness layout; OPENCODE_HARNESS_ROOT env remains the primary override and is documented.
comments.falsification: Set OPENCODE_HARNESS_ROOT to a different path and verify setup uses it; the fallback is only a last resort.

comments.problem: environment uses {env:VAR} placeholders which expand only if the variables exist in the parent environment; missing vars create empty values.
comments.suggestion: Intended: same semantics as the original .mcp.json. Empty values are tolerated by the academic-search server (optional keys).
comments.falsification: Launch the academic-search MCP with no keys in the environment and verify tools/list still returns 7 tools.

comments.problem: importlib.import_module('pymupdf') under pymupdf4llm: PyMuPDF package provides the pymupdf import name; if only pymupdf4llm is installed without core, check errors.
comments.suggestion: Harness installs pymupdf4llm which pulls pymupdf; smoke test (--json exit=0) confirms the pair resolves in the current venv.
comments.falsification: Run `pip uninstall pymupdf` in a scratch venv and confirm check-deps.py reports the missing dependency instead of raising.

verified_by_commands: python -c "import json; json.load(open(manifest)); json.load(open(opencode.json))" # both valid

out_of_scope_gaps.finding: Live OpenCode re-load of the new plugin is not exercised in-session (config change requires restart); stub-down verification done via node --check only.

tests.name: plugin registration + MCP env passthrough
tests.command: python -c "assert any('paper-review-plugin' in p for p in c['plugin']); assert c['mcp']['academic-search']['environment'] == {'CROSSREF_MAILTO':'{env:CROSSREF_MAILTO}','SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY':'{env:SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY}'}"
tests.expected: plugin in plugin[], environment present with {env:VAR} placeholders

process_analysis.notes: Worker produced code + tests; reviewer verified files independently; tester ran deterministic commands; no role mixing (written_by matches every submitted agent_type).

data.justification: All three required gates pass. The port maps each Claude-only artifact to a working OpenCode equivalent: manifest.json mirrors plugin.json metadata and adds an opencode mapping; .mcp.json env pass-through lives in .opencode/opencode.json with {env:VAR} substitution; hooks/hooks.json became a dependency-free V2 plugin registering ctx.session.hook('context') after a check-deps probe. Deterministic checks (T1-T5) pass 5/5. Remaining gap is only that a live OpenCode restart is needed to observe the newly registered plugin.

The port maps each Claude-only artifact to a working OpenCode equivalent: manifest.json mirrors plugin.json metadata and adds an opencode mapping; .mcp.json env pass-through lives in .opencode/opencode.json with {env:VAR} substitution; hooks/hooks.json became a dependency-free V2 plugin registering ctx.session.hook('context') after a check-deps probe. Deterministic checks (T1-T5) pass 5/5. Remaining gap is only that a live OpenCode restart is needed to observe the newly registered plugin.
